rules.profileAndTownIdle: Always use the on-foot idle.png even while mounted.
rules.fieldVariant: Use mounted only when player.mountState.mounted and the character motion map provides a mounted variant.
rules.packedAtlas: Render frame_sets region + targetOffsetX/targetOffsetY + flipX; logical cell remains 256x256.
rules.directionPolicy: Idle/Walk use five-source mirror policy; Attack uses two-source mirror/alias policy; Cast/Dead use optimizer validation fallback.
rules.sharedHurtDeadAtlas: hurt and dead point to the same dead JSON; Runtime selects the requested frame_set.
rules.hurtDeadFrames: hurt=first 3 frames; dead=all 4 frames and holds final frame.
rules.jobAppearanceLayers: novice/high_novice shared; first/high-first shared; second/trans-second shared; third and fourth unique.
rules.bardDancerGenderLock: Bard line is male-only and Dancer line is female-only; cross-gender replacement assets are absent by design.
rules.assassinMixedDualFallback: sword+dagger and dagger+sword display dual_dagger first, then dual_sword, without changing real equipment damage.
rules.mageStaffAppearance: one-hand and two-hand staff use the same staff animation; equipment handedness remains unchanged.
rules.merchantCartAppearance: No cart body variant is used; cart skills reuse normal attack/cast animations.
rules.legacyAssetsRemoved: The previous fixed-grid character atlases were removed before installing the packed deployment library.
rules.skillActionMotion: Physical attack skills use the current weapon Attack atlas; magic/heal/buff/debuff/support skills use Cast.
rules.weaponHandVisualSharing: One-hand and two-hand sword/axe/staff share the same visual atlas when only one appearance set exists; equipment handedness and combat values remain real.
